title: Gerente de Consultoria e Contencioso Tributário
description: Contexte et environnement A TotalEnergies Brasil est enquadrada no grupo de Grandes Contribuintes sob regime de "Acompanhamento Tributário e Econômico Especial" da Receita Federal. Contexte et environnement A TotalEnergies Brasil est enquadrada no grupo de Grandes Contribuintes sob regime de "Acompanhamento Tributário e Econômico Especial" da Receita Federal. O sistema judiciário brasileiro é complexo e multifacetado, com diversas jurisdições e instâncias recursais. O ambiente fiscal brasileiro é denso, complexo e instável (expectativa de implementação da Reforma Tributária sobre o consumo, Pilar 2 da OCDE, entre outros temas). O contencioso tributário brasileiro envolve montantes significativos, geralmente variando entre 50% e 75% do PIB do país. Empresas com débitos inscritos em Dívida Ativa podem ser impedidas de participar de rodadas de licitação. Activités Principales Atividades Coordenar a execução do Controle SOX de Contencioso Tributário, interagindo com as equipes de Tributos Diretos e Indiretos para capturar corretamente as informações relevantes. Garantir que os escritórios de advocacia responsáveis pelos processos tributários estejam alinhados à estratégia do Grupo, conforme definida pelo Gerente Sênior Tributário, em articulação com Tax/HQ e CFO da TTE. Elaborar relatórios de litígios em nível de Joint Venture (JV) e assegurar uma comunicação eficaz com os parceiros, buscando aprovações quando necessário. Garantir que os controles contábeis reflitam adequadamente os saldos de provisões para contingências tributárias e depósitos judiciais. Garantir que as posições fiscais incertas estejam devidamente documentadas ou, quando aplicável, sejam objeto da respectiva provisão tributária. Estabelecer rotinas de reporte com as equipes de Tributos Diretos e Indiretos para monitoramento de potenciais litígios. Definir a melhor estrutura tributária a ser adotada localmente (Brasil) para cada ativo de E&P (Repetro, regimes tributários etc.). Prestar suporte tributário a todos os departamentos da TEPBR, especialmente SCLC, LSO, OBO e JVs. Prestar suporte tributário à área de GRP e outras áreas não operacionais, em coordenação com o Gerente Sênior Tributário. Revisar relatórios de contencioso tributário e de alterações legislativas, além de executar os controles SOX. Avaliar todas as permissões e autorizações necessárias para operações comerciais. Garantir o adequado acompanhamento de fiscalizações tributárias realizadas pelas Receitas Federal, Estadual e Municipal, bem como pela Agência Nacional do Petróleo (ANP), coordenando a obtenção de documentos de suporte, interações com escritórios de advocacia e outras áreas da TotalEnergies sempre que necessário. Executar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de SMS (Saúde, Meio Ambiente e Segurança), alinhado aos princípios do One Maestro e orientado à preservação da integridade das pessoas, do meio ambiente, dos ativos e da reputação da Companhia. Atuar como ponto focal para estudos e análises da Reforma Tributária, disseminando os impactos às áreas envolvidas em coordenação com o Gerente Sênior Tributário. Representar os interesses da TotalEnergies em assuntos tributários junto a associações do setor (como IBP e GETAP), em coordenação com o Gerente Sênior Tributário. Responsabilités Elaborar e atualizar relatórios de contencioso tributário, considerando as particularidades dos diversos destinatários, como equipes de Contabilidade e Jurídico, matriz (HQ), parceiros em JVs e autoridades governamentais. Executar o Controle SOX de Contencioso Tributário. Atuar junto a advogados tributaristas externos para analisar, discutir e aprovar argumentos apresentados em processos em andamento. Avaliar, juntamente com o Gerente Tributário, advogados externos e associações de classe (IBP e GETAP), as estratégias de litígio. Liderar e/ou participar de discussões em associações do setor com o objetivo de aprimorar a legislação tributária em consonância com os interesses da Companhia (advocacy). Apoiar a gestão do orçamento referente a escritórios de advocacia externos e monitorar procedimentos de cobrança. Interagir com stakeholders internos da afiliada e da matriz para reunir documentação e informações necessárias à preparação tempestiva de respostas às autoridades fiscais. Gerenciar prazos e atuar como principal ponto de contato com representantes da Administração Tributária. Pesquisar, analisar e interpretar alterações legislativas, avaliando potenciais impactos para o negócio. Avaliar impactos e riscos tributários em operações comerciais, contratos, acordos e alterações na estrutura societária, buscando mitigá-los, em conjunto com equipes internas (Compliance Tributário, Operações, Finanças, RH, Jurídico, P&D, HQ) e stakeholders externos (consultorias e associações). Prestar consultoria tributária visando otimizar e simplificar a estrutura e a carga tributária da Companhia. Garantir a validade de certidões fiscais, autorizações tributárias e regimes especiais. Assegurar o cumprimento das políticas e procedimentos internos da Companhia, atender solicitações da matriz (por exemplo, apresentações de missão e Fiche Fiscale) e organizar treinamentos e apresentações para as equipes tributárias e demais áreas. Profil du candidat Graduação em Direito (graduação em Ciências Contábeis será considerada um diferencial importante). Mínimo de 12 anos de experiência na área tributária, preferencialmente no setor de Óleo e Gás (experiência anterior em firmas Big Four será altamente valorizada). Informations supplémentaires TotalEnergies valorise la diversité, promeut le développement individuel et offre des opportunités d'emploi égales à tous les candidats. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Analista de Dados Sr
description: TotalPass Descrição da vaga Buscamos um(a) profissional para transformar dados em informações estratégicas e informações em conhecimento para o negócio, conectando pessoas, processos e decisões. Atuar na identificação de necessidades das áreas clientes, compreensão dos desafios de negócio, construção e gestão de pipelines de dados e desenvolvimento de visualizações e storytelling analítico que gerem insights acionáveis. Além disso, aplicar e orientar análises avançadas por meio de modelagem estatística e algoritmos de machine learning, contribuindo para o aumento da eficiência operacional, a aceleração da tomada de decisão e o fortalecimento de uma cultura orientada por dados. Responsabilidades e atribuições Desenvolver modelos preditivos para antecipar gargalos operacionais e avaliar impactos decorrentes de mudanças regulatórias, como a evolução dos percentuais de biodiesel no diesel e etanol na gasolina, apoiando a tomada de decisão e o planejamento do negócio; Conduzir estudos de modelagem e otimização logística, promovendo ganhos de eficiência por meio da redução de tempos de ciclo, aumento da produtividade, maior assertividade nos faturamentos e melhor utilização dos ativos; Realizar análises de filas, tempos e movimentos, identificando oportunidades de melhoria contínua e aumento da performance dos processos operacionais; Aplicar técnicas de pesquisa operacional, otimização matemática, simulação de cenários e analytics avançado para maximizar a eficiência operacional, suportar a gestão de capacidades e avaliar restrições de ativos e infraestrutura; Identificar, priorizar e apoiar a avaliação de oportunidades de investimento (CAPEX), considerando critérios técnicos, operacionais e econômico-financeiros, direcionando recursos para iniciativas de maior geração de valor para o negócio; Desenvolver modelos de apoio à decisão que suportem o planejamento estratégico e operacional das unidades em âmbito nacional, incluindo bases, aeroportos, terminais e depósitos de químicos; Liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas, de dados e Inteligência Artificial para a Diretoria, atuando desde a identificação de oportunidades até a implementação de soluções que gerem impacto para o negócio; Atuar como referência em Dados e IA para as áreas clientes, traduzindo desafios de negócio em soluções escaláveis e orientadas por dados, em parceria com a TI, que exercerá papel de direcionamento, governança e habilitação tecnológica, enquanto o desenvolvimento e a evolução das soluções passam a ser conduzidos pela área de negócio com recursos dedicados. Requisitos e qualificações Graduação em Banco de Dados, Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia de Dados ou áreas correlatas; Experiência consolidada em análise de dados e geração de insights para suporte à tomada de decisão; Conhecimento avançado em Python e SQL para manipulação, tratamento e análise de dados; Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Tableau, Power BI ou similares; Vivência na construção de dashboards e indicadores gerenciais; Habilidade para traduzir dados complexos em recomendações de negócio; Experiência em ambientes colaborativos e multidisciplinares. Conhecimentos Desejáveis Ferramentas de ETL e preparação de dados, como Alteryx e Tableau Prep; Desenvolvimento de análises avançadas e automação de processos analíticos; Conhecimento em modelagem estatística e técnicas de analytics; Certificações em Analytics e Dados, como Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) ou similares. E tem mais, confira o nosso pacote de benefícios: Plano de Saúde e Odontológico – Bradesco – extensivo a dependentes PAE - Auxílio financeiro oferecido no caso de dependentes filhos(as) e/ou enteados(as) com deficiência intelectual Convênio Farmácia . Descontos de até 85% Previdência Complementar – Plano FlexPrev - variando de 1% a 11%, de acordo com o salário Seguro de Vida – seguro para todos os colaboradores a partir da data de admissão, sem participação. Extensão das Licenças - Maternidade (total de 180 dias) e Paternidade (total de 20 dias). Vale-Alimentação e/ou Refeição – Caju Benefícios Auxílio-Educacional - Para dependentes até o ensino médio. TotalPass Assinatura Solar - Possibilidade de obter desconto especial na conta de energia a partir da adesão a um plano de geração distribuída. Clube Smiles Corporativo - Descontos de até 50% nos planos oferecidos para você planejar suas viagens. Disponível também para cônjuge e filhos 18+. Adicional por tempo de serviço – Oferecemos ao colaborador um adicional de salário (de acordo ao tempo de casa) a ser pago por ocasião de férias. E para o desenvolvimento de nossas equipes... Plataforma de Aprendizagem: Trilha dos valores vibra e curadoria renomada com mais de 200 opções de cursos disponíveis para acesso a qualquer tempo. Recrutamento Interno: Divulgação das vagas disponíveis em todo Brasil, incentivando a mobilidade interna. Temos orgulho de ser uma empresa brasileira e de nossa presença em todo o território nacional. Quem Somos? Somos a Vibra, uma empresa jovem que já nasceu grande, uma das cinco maiores empresas do Brasil , com uma base de investidores diversificada e global. Com mais de 50 anos de experiência e um time competente e comprometido, atendemos mais de 30 milhões de pessoas que passam nos nossos mais de 8000 postos , por meio de nossos revendedores de norte a sul do país; e 26 mil clientes empresariais. Aqui, temos ritmo na entrega de resultados e respeito nas relações. Escutamos com empatia e entregamos com agilidade. Agimos com protagonismo e colaboramos para fazer acontecer. Falamos com transparência , agimos com integridade e cumprimos os combinados. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Especialista de Processos Tecnológicos Comerciais (Salesforce)
description: Conheça o Nosso Jeito Neoenergia e seja parte! Fazer parte da Neoenergia é atuar em uma empresa líder do setor elétrico, presente em 18 estados e no Distrito Federal, ao lado de mais de 16 mil profissionais. Com mais de R$ 50 bilhões em investimentos previstos para os próximos anos, estamos construindo o futuro da energia no Brasil. Quer crescer com a gente? Nossos negócios estão divididos nas áreas de geração, transmissão, distribuição e comercialização. As suas distribuidoras, Neoenergia Coelba (BA), Neoenergia Pernambuco (PE), Neoenergia Cosern (RN), Neoenergia Elektro (SP/MS) e Neoenergia Brasília (DF) atendem a cerca de 17 milhões de clientes. Vivemos o Nosso Jeito Neoenergia, guiados por valores como atitude de dono, humanização, agilidade e foco na resolução, sempre buscando gerar valor para nossos clientes, colaboradores, parceiros e para a sociedade. Confira os detalhes da vaga e venha construir um futuro melhor com a gente! Local de Trabalho: Flamengo/Rio de Janeiro ou Campinas/São Paulo. Sua energia será muito importante para: Atuará de forma integrada com uma equipe desenvolvedora externa, como parte de um único time, contribuindo com a visão técnica e estratégica sobre Salesforce Energy & Utilities para definir a melhor abordagem das necessidades de negócio. Seu conhecimento técnico será essencial para validar propostas, orientar decisões, assegurar a qualidade das soluções e acompanhar os desenvolvimentos de forma colaborativa. Atividades: Conduzir as demandas de tecnologia da torre de negócio sob sua responsabilidade, organizando, priorizando e estruturando as necessidades dos clientes internos; Atuar como ponto central de articulação entre cliente interno, áreas técnicas da TI e áreas de suporte, garantindo alinhamento e fluidez na tomada de decisão; Tracionar e coordenar o processo de viabilização financeira e técnica das demandas, incluindo estimativas, construção de orçamento; Coordenar os projetos da torre em todo o seu ciclo de vida, desde a estruturação da demanda até a entrega, assegurando controle de escopo, prazo, custo, riscos e dependências; Conduzir fóruns de acompanhamento e decisão, garantindo clareza sobre prioridades, pendências, riscos e encaminhamentos; Gerir o relacionamento com fornecedores, acompanhando contratos, entregas, riscos e desvios; Assegurar clareza executiva contínua sobre o status da torre, decisões necessárias, riscos relevantes e impactos para o negócio; Atuar de forma consistente em fóruns de acompanhamento e decisão, com comunicação clara e direcionada ao nível executivo; Organizar, priorizar e conduzir demandas de múltiplos stakeholders, com foco em decisão e entrega. Para fazer parte do nosso time, você precisa ter: Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Tecnologia, Administração ou áreas correlatas; Vivência com condução de demandas e projetos de tecnologia em salesforce; Experiência em Salesforce Energy & Utilitie, particularmente Sales e Service Cloud; Domínio prático e teórico da gestão de projeto, com experiência; Atuação com gestão orçamentária de projetos ou processos; Vivência com gestão de fornecedores, incluindo acompanhamento de entregas, prazos, riscos e desvios. Será um diferencial se você tiver: Espanhol nível intermediário. Para você ficar com a energia lá em cima, confira nossos benefícios: Plano de Saúde e Odontológico para cuidar de você e de seus dependentes. Vale Alimentação para fazer aquele mercado reforçado ou Vale Refeição para confraternizar com os colegas no horário de almoço; Participação nos Lucros e Resultados da empresa, o momento mais esperado do ano!; Programas de qualidade de vida que garantem o bem-estar e promovem a saúde dos nossos colaboradores; Licença maternidade estendida, para um puerpério com mais tranquilidade; Licença paternidade, para ficar bem perto da sua família nos primeiros dias do bebê; Totalpass para você fazer atividade física e ficar cheio de energia; Programa de Idiomas para você poder se aperfeiçoar em outro idioma; Previdência Privada para você ter um futuro mais tranquilo; Seguro de Vida para apoiar nossos colaboradores em todos os momentos. Suministramos energía a casi 100 millones de personas en decenas de países y desarrolla sus actividades renovables, de red y comerciales en Europa (España, Reino Unido, Portugal, Francia, Alemania, Italia y Grecia), Estados Unidos, Brasil y Australia y está presente en mercados como Japón y Polonia, entre otros. ¿Quieres formar parte de la energía del futuro? title: Senior Full Stack Developer (React & Node.js)
description: You are a Senior Full Stack Developer with a strong backend focus who enjoys building scalable, cloud-native applications using TypeScript across the entire stack. While you'll contribute across both frontend and backend development, your primary focus will be designing and building robust serverless backend services while delivering modern React user experiences. You thrive working within established architectures, quickly understanding existing codebases and delivering production-ready solutions with minimal supervision. You take ownership of your work, write clean and maintainable code, and believe software quality is everyone's responsibility. You are proactive, analytical, and collaborative, enjoying close partnerships with cross-functional teams while actively contributing to Agile ceremonies and continuously improving engineering practices. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies 5+ years of professional experience as a Full Stack Software Developer or Software Engineer. Strong experience developing production applications using TypeScript across both frontend and backend. Strong experience building modern web applications with React . Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs using OpenAPI . Experience implementing schema validation using Zod or similar libraries. Experience building serverless applications using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and DynamoDB . Strong understanding of DynamoDB Single-Table Design and access-pattern modeling. Experience provisioning infrastructure using AWS CDK or similar Infrastructure as Code tools. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and code quality tools. Experience writing automated unit tests using Vitest or similar frameworks. Familiarity with automated testing using Playwright , Postman , or similar tools. Experience working with modern React technologies such as TanStack Router/Query , Mantine UI , Zustand , or similar libraries. Understanding of secure coding practices involving sensitive customer information (PII/PCI). Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills. Self-driven with the ability to work independently while contributing effectively within Agile teams. Advanced English communication skills, both written and spoken. You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using TypeScript across React frontend and Node.js backend services. Build and enhance cloud-native, serverless applications using AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and AWS CDK. Develop modern React user interfaces using established frontend patterns and component libraries. Design efficient DynamoDB data models using Single-Table Design and optimized access patterns. Develop secure and scalable RESTful APIs following OpenAPI specifications and implement schema validation using Zod. Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following established engineering standards and best practices. Create comprehensive unit tests while supporting automated API and end-to-end testing initiatives when needed. Participate in code reviews while ensuring high standards for quality, performance, maintainability, and security. Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and continuously improve application reliability. Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, product owners, and other stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle. Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, retrospectives, and backlog refinement. Take ownership of the solutions you build from implementation through deployment and production support. Nice to Have Experience with SQL Server. Experience with Amazon EventBridge. Experience with OpenSearch Serverless. Experience with Playwright. Experience working with Specification-Driven Development practices. Additional Information About Us We Are Engineered Different. At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Chefe de Financeiro — Liderança
description: Sobre a Vaga Buscamos um(a) Chefe de Financeiro para liderar nossa equipe e otimizar a gestão financeira da organização. Este profissional será fundamental para a tomada de decisões estratégicas, garantindo a solidez e o crescimento sustentável de nossos negócios. Responsabilidades Liderar e desenvolver a equipe financeira, promovendo um ambiente de alta performance e colaboração. Gerenciar as operações financeiras diárias, incluindo contas a pagar/receber, tesouraria e fluxo de caixa. Elaborar e monitorar orçamentos, previsões financeiras e planos de negócios, garantindo o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos. Analisar indicadores financeiros e econômicos, reportando resultados à diretoria e propondo ações corretivas. Assegurar a conformidade com as obrigações fiscais, contábeis e regulatórias vigentes no Brasil. Otimizar processos financeiros, buscando eficiência e inovação na gestão dos recursos. Participar ativamente de projetos estratégicos da empresa, oferecendo suporte financeiro e análises de viabilidade. title: Driller - Brazil
description: Job Summary The Driller is the onsite focal point for all well operations and Main Deck activities, under the overall control of the Rig Superintendent, and is responsible for Supervising onsite well operations activities, and for ensuring that the operation is completed safely & efficiently in accordance with the approved program and Company policies & procedures. Position title: Driller – Siem Helix Reports to: Toolpusher Job Summary The Driller is the onsite focal point for all well operations and Main Deck activities, under the overall control of the Rig Superintendent, and is responsible for Supervising onsite well operations activities, and for ensuring that the operation is completed safely & efficiently in accordance with the approved program and Company policies & procedures. The Driller will be conversant with all statutory requirements relating to Well Control and Well Intervention, with all personnel directly or indirectly involved with well operations conforming to the instructions issued by them. Duties & Responsibilities Coordinate, when needed, the Deck Supervisor on his supervision of the deck crew and 3rd Party/vendors on deck Liaise with the Tool Pusher and On Shift Client Representative regarding any changes to the approved well program and communicate these requested changes to all personnel working under their supervision. As delegate of the Rig Superintendent/ Tool Pusher, secure the well in emergency situations and always be aware of environmental aspects. Ensure that the Tool Pusher, Rig Superintendent and Client are advised of all current and/or changing conditions. Under instruction from the Tool Pusher they will conduct Emergency Disconnection Drill to ensure that all personnel are familiar with these operations and record the results in the Operations Daily report. First line is responsible for carrying out the well control and EDS procedures in situations of need emergency disconnect. Under instruction from the Tool pusher usher and or Rig Superintendent they will conduct Well Control Drills. Ensure that well control equipment is correctly maintained, installed and pressure tested. Take direction from the Tool Pusher in all Well Control Operations. Ensure that they have full understanding of the vessels Well Control Philosophy that includes the current HdB Policies on Well Control & Barriers. Request written dispensation from the tool pusher for any operations that cannot be carried out under the Helix Well Control & Barrier Policies. Conduct Pre-shift, TBT’s, TOFS, Daily drills, & weekly safety meetings with their crew. Ensure that Helix Health & Safety policies are communicated to and understood by all crew members. Ensure that all Supervisors communicate through toolbox meetings, all operational safety aspects of the 12-hour shift. In conjunction with the Tool pusher ensure vessel Well Operations Personnel are being trained to meet the company’s training matrix requirements. Ensure that the appropriate logs and records are maintained throughout their shift. As part of the Offshore Management Team, meet daily to discuss previous 24 hours and ongoing operations. As part of the Offshore Management Team, meet as and when situations dictate, they are required. Be responsible for the adherence to Helix and Client safety & PPE policies by all personnel working on deck. Be responsible for the adherence to Helix & Statutory Lifting procedures and requirements by all personnel under his supervision. Record all relevant operational information (including but not limited to tool string and subsea equipment data, dimensions, hanging weights, overpulls etc.). They will ensure that this data is readily available in the doghouse throughout the project as required and officially recorded in their daily operational log. Be competent to operate the MPT and associated MPT systems. Directly supervise & record the opening and closing of the Intervention System and Subsea Tree. Ensure, on an ongoing basis, that all parties under their supervision have clear and effective lines of communication as required, and will ensure that operations do not commence until this is in place and confirmed. Ensure that operations are carried out in accordance with the latest instruction issued by the OMT with reference to the project documentation where required, and that all personnel under their supervision are clear as regards their role in the forward operation. Complete appraisal for all members of their crew & ensure that it is given to the Tool Pusher or Rig superintendent prior to their departure at the end of each trip. Instigate weekly DROPS inspections, ensuring actions are corrected, reported & logged in the DROPS register. Assist the vessel Maintenance team & Chief Engineer to maintain vessel equipment. Review and as required, perform all safety control duties as per rig´s specific HSE Case, Safety Case, HAZOP and JSAs. Perform, respecting any applicable license limitation and under supervision, similar responsibilities Tool Pusher for training, qualification and temporary coverage purposes. Perform, if required, the same duties as the Assistant Driller. QHSE: Following and complying with all the company's health, safety and environment policies, objectives/ targets and procedures Minimum Qualifications Requirements High school diploma or equivalent. Minimum 3 experience effectively working as a Driller or equivalent in well intervention projects. Qualification As per Helix training and competence directives. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Analista de Benefícios Pleno

Realizar a análise de indicadores, consolidar dados de sinistralidade, absenteísmo relacionado à saúde, adesão aos programas e custos per capita para apoiar o nível sênior e a gerência na tomada de decisões. Gerir as Plataformas de Benefícios Flexíveis, Administrar saldos, regras de elegibilidade e parametrização em ferramentas digitais de benefícios (quando aplicável à estrutura da empresa). Assegurar que todas as práticas de benefícios estejam em total conformidade com a CLT, acordos sindicais (CCTs), leis de vale-transporte e regulamentações da ANS. Experiência com a rotina de Folha de Pagamento compreensão clara de como os eventos de benefícios impactam o fechamento de folha (descontos, coparticipações, encargos e provisões). Orientação para Detalhes e Acurácia Rigor extremo com números e cadastros, visto que pequenos erros em massa geram grandes prejuízos financeiros ou falhas no atendimento ao colega. Experiência com múltiplos sistemas e ERPs: (como SAP, ADP, Workday ou plataformas específicas de benefícios) e os portais descentralizados de diferentes operadoras e corretoras. "Porque saúde é o que interessa."\ Plano Odontológico: para que o seu sorriso fique sempre impecável e bonito. Vale Transporte: para facilitar o seu deslocamento. Vale Alimentação e Vale Refeição: porque fazer compras vale mais que mil palavras. Local de trabalho: Barra da Tijuca ( Modelo híbrido 1x na semana em Home Office). title: Analista de Segurança da Informação (Cibersegurança) Sênior
description: Analista de Segurança da Informação (Cibersegurança) Sênior Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee Como Analista de Segurança da Informação (Cibersegurança) Sênior na Montreal, você fará parte de uma das melhores empresas de tecnologia do Brasil. Nossa trajetória iniciou há mais de trinta anos com uma pequena equipe de engenharia apaixonada por inovação. Em 1986, pessoas visionárias fizeram um compromisso com a tecnologia e sua capacidade de transformar o mundo. Aquele, seria apenas o começo de uma trajetória que nos tornou referência sólida no mercado e uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar. Cibersegurança: atuar tecnicamente na identificação, análise, investigação e tratamento de eventos, incidentes, vulnerabilidades e riscos de Cibersegurança. Interface técnica com SOC/MSS: atuar como ponto focal técnico interno junto ao parceiro responsável pelo SOC/MSS, acompanhando os eventos, alertas, incidentes, indicadores e entregas relacionadas à Cibersegurança. Acompanhamento de Eventos: acompanhar os eventos e incidentes identificados pelo SOC/MSS, analisando criticidade, impacto, evidências e recomendações, contribuindo para a definição das ações de tratamento junto às áreas responsáveis. Análise de Indicadores: acompanhar e analisar os indicadores de Cibersegurança apresentados pelo parceiro, identificando tendências, desvios, reincidências, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria. Relatórios Técnicos e Executivos: analisar os relatórios periódicos do SOC/MSS, validando informações, incidentes, vulnerabilidades, indicadores, recomendações e demais informações relevantes, contribuindo para os reportes à gestão. Resposta a Incidentes: participar tecnicamente do tratamento de incidentes de segurança, atuando junto ao SOC/MSS e às equipes internas na investigação, contenção, correção e acompanhamento das ações necessárias. Investigação de Segurança: realizar análises complementares de eventos e incidentes, utilizando logs, evidências, indicadores de comprometimento (IoCs) e informações provenientes das ferramentas de segurança. Threat Intelligence: acompanhar informações sobre ameaças, vulnerabilidades, campanhas, técnicas e indicadores de comprometimento relevantes ao ambiente da empresa, avaliando possíveis impactos. description: Agente Saneamento Água I - Exclusiva para Mulheres Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local. A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas. Programa Respeito dá o Tom A programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. A Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança. A Aegea tem o compromisso com apromoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças. Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características. description: Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee O Hospital Maternidade Maria Amélia Buarque de Hollanda integra a Rede de Atenção materno-infantil e ginecológica no Município do Rio de Janeiro. Elas funcionam 24 horas e são instaladas sempre ao lado de um grande hospital de emergência, absorvendo o atendimento dos casos de menor complexidade. Técnico de Laboratório Completo Experiência de 06 (seis) meses na função de Técnico de Laboratório. A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970. A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão. A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação. Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental. Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber. Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros. O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS. O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo. Inclusão A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades. Missão Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental. Visão Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Aqui, segurança, integridade, colaboração e simplificação são a forma como a gente trabalha. Conhecimento em redes industriais, metrologia e sistemas de calibração. Experiência com terceirizados, telemetria e melhoria contínua (TPM, Lean ou WCM). Inglês técnico. title: Product Owner (PO) | Produtos Digitais | Canais dos Produtores
description: Job description #VemSerMAG Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar! Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work. Somos uma empresa PLURAL! Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão. Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros. Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil. Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década. Quer fazer parte dessa história? Gerenciar o ciclo de vida dos produtos digitais dos produtores, garantindo evolução contínua e geração de valor; Definir e comunicar a visão do produto, objetivos e roadmap; Conduzir iniciativas de discovery, identificando oportunidades e necessidades dos produtores; Priorizar demandas e backlog, considerando impacto para o negócio, experiência do usuário e viabilidade técnica; Atuar em parceria com Tecnologia, Negócios e demais áreas envolvidas na evolução dos produtos; Acompanhar indicadores e métricas de produto, utilizando dados para apoiar decisões e identificar oportunidades de melhoria; Garantir a evolução das jornadas e dos canais digitais dos produtores; Conduzir alinhamentos com stakeholders e promover uma visão integrada entre produto, negócio e tecnologia; Participar dos ritos e cerimônias da squad, garantindo clareza sobre prioridades, objetivos e entregas; Acompanhar a cadência das entregas e os resultados das iniciativas, promovendo melhoria contínua. Requirements and skills O que esperamos de você? Ensino superior completo em Administração, Tecnologia, Sistemas de Informação, Marketing ou áreas correlatas . title: Product Operations Specialist | Fraud Operations Processes
description: About Us At Félix, we're building the financial ecosystem for Latin immigrants in the U.S., starting with a revolution in remittances. Our core product is an AI‑powered chatbot built on WhatsApp, allowing our users to send money home as easily as sending a text message. We leverage cutting‑edge technology like AI, blockchain, and stablecoins to make cross‑border payments faster, more affordable, and more accessible than ever before. We are a hyper‑growth Series B company, backed by over $100 million in funding from top‑tier global investors, including QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, and General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavour Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award. We are a group of extremely talented and dedicated high‑performers, united by our shared obsession with a single goal: empowering our customers. We are all owners of Félix, driven by a bias for action and a true experimentation spirit to get shit done with urgency and focus. Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users' lives better. We are building the future, today. About The Role As a Product Operations Specialist focused on Fraud Operations Processes, you will not just execute risk policies—you will be the architect of how our fraud operations scale. In a hyper‑growth fintech environment moving millions of dollars over WhatsApp, efficiency, speed, and accuracy are paramount. Your mission is to own, audit, and optimize our entire Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) library, bridging the gap between risk management, product capability, and operational execution. You will map out, fix and scale complex workflows, identify automation opportunities alongside Engineering and Product, and package high‑volume processes so they are ready to be seamlessly executed and ready to stop fraud while ensuring the legitimate user experience. Your ultimate goal is to build bulletproof, invisible guardrails that mitigate fraud while ensuring a frictionless user journey for legitimate customers recovering from false declines. Responsibilities SOP Architecture & Process Scalability: Maintain, continuously improve, and own the single source of truth for all live fraud operational processes. Standardize and document high‑volume workflows into clear, repeatable, step‑by‑step processes that can be executed consistently by any team member with minimal ramp‑up or oversight. Governance & Audit Cadence: Design and execute internal monitoring mechanisms, dashboards, and spot‑checks for core processes to ensure compliance, maintain high quality, and significantly improve user journey. Process Metrics & KPIs: Define, track, and optimize key health metrics for fraud workflows, including process adherence, operational throughput, and process quality. Automation & Tooling Improvement: Identify systemic operational bottlenecks, build data‑driven business cases for automation, and partner directly with Product Ops and Engineering to implement tools that eliminate manual overhead. Change Control & Strategic Alignment: Own versioning, sign‑off, and cross‑functional communication whenever a process evolves. Partner closely with Workforce Management (WFM), Quality and Training to ensure updates are instantly reflected in capacity models and training calibrations. User Experience Safeguarding: Ensure that while minimizing fraud risk, the user recovery journey is seamless, minimizing friction when legitimate users face false declines. Requirements Fraud/Payments Domain Expertise: Solid understanding of financial fraud risk vectors and known patterns. SOP & Process Engineering: Proven track record of mapping, documenting, and scaling complex operational workflows within high‑growth fintechs or tech environments. Automation & Outsourcing Mindset: Experience prepping operational processes for automation or external vendors, with a sharp eye for separating high‑judgment tasks from transactional ones. Data Fluency: Strong hands‑on experience querying data (SQL, BigQuery, Omni, or similar) to extract process metrics, build operational dashboards, and back up business cases with hard numbers. Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills to align cross‑functional teams including Customer Operations, WFM, Product, Quality Assurance, and multiple stakeholders. Autonomy under Ambiguity: A true "owner" mentality with a strong bias for action, capable of navigating and creating structure out of unstructured startup environments. Language Proficiency: Professional fluency and advanced communication skills in English. These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered. description: About Nu Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 135 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. About Nu Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 135 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. Visit our Institutional Page About The Role We are looking for an engineer who has already built with AI in production. You have shipped LLM-powered systems (agents, copilots, RAG pipelines, or AI-driven automations), you know what breaks when they meet real users, and you know how to make them reliable enough for business-critical workflows. Your day-to-day is applied AI engineering: designing agentic workflows, integrating LLMs into internal tools and business processes, building evaluation and guardrail layers, and turning manual, high-friction workflows into AI-assisted ones that thousands of Nubankers depend on. This is not an infrastructure role. You will not spend your days on Terraform, IAM policies, or email deliverability. Cloud fluency helps, but the core of this job is the AI layer - prompts, context, agents, evaluations, integrations - and the product judgment to know where AI genuinely helps versus where deterministic automation is the right answer. Key Responsibilities Applied AI & Agentic Systems Design, build, and ship LLM-powered agents and workflows that automate complex internal processes end-to-end. Work hands-on with frontier models and the modern AI stack: tool/function calling, structured outputs, MCP, RAG, multi-agent orchestration. Own the full lifecycle of an AI system: from problem discovery and prototype to production hardening, monitoring, and iteration. Evaluation & Reliability Build evaluation harnesses, guardrails, and quality feedback loops so AI systems can be trusted in production - not just demoed. Define what "good" looks like for non-deterministic systems and instrument it: evals, regression suites, human-in-the-loop review where it matters. Intelligent Workflow Automation Use orchestration platforms (e.g., n8n) and custom integrations as delivery vehicles for AI-in-the-loop automation across business units. Integrate enterprise platforms (Slack, Google Workspace, Jira, internal APIs) into coherent, AI-assisted workflows. AI Adoption & Governance Drive the technical strategy for AI adoption within engineering and business workflows. Develop governance frameworks that make AI coding assistants and agents safe, compliant, and effective - balancing developer freedom with security and operational risk. Multiplier Work Create Golden Paths, reference implementations, and documentation that let other teams build AI workflows safely on their own. For Lead/IC6: act as the technical reference for applied AI in the domain, influence architecture beyond the immediate team, mentor senior engineers, and partner with ITSec and Privacy to align AI solutions with company policy. For Senior/IC5: execute complex AI projects with high autonomy, identify workflow bottlenecks worth automating, and mentor mid-level engineers. What are we looking for? Must Have - Demonstrated Applied AI Experience Shipped LLM systems in production: at least one real system with an LLM at its core - an agent, copilot, RAG application, or AI-driven automation - used by real users, not a proof of concept. Hands-on AI engineering: practical fluency with prompt and context engineering, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and agent frameworks or orchestration patterns. Evaluation mindset: experience measuring and improving AI output quality - evals, test sets, feedback loops - and an honest understanding of failure modes (hallucination, drift, prompt injection). Solid software engineering foundation: proficiency in Python, TypeScript, or Clojure; strong API and integration skills; the discipline to ship maintainable systems, not notebooks. AI product sense: the judgment to identify which problems deserve an LLM, which need deterministic automation, and which should not be automated at all. Nice to Have Experience with workflow automation platforms (n8n, Zapier, or custom orchestration engines). Exposure to cloud services (AWS) and infrastructure-as-code. Familiarity with AI developer tooling (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) and AI governance practices. Behavioral & Strategic Skills Builder bias: you prototype fast, validate with real users, and harden what works. Governance-aware: you understand that "efficiency" must be balanced with "security", and you can design AI systems that are safe by default without destroying velocity. Multiplier: you enjoy documenting your work, creating Golden Paths, and teaching others how to use what you build. Comfortable with ambiguity: AI capabilities shift monthly; you treat that as an opportunity to re-solve problems better, not as churn. Visit our Institutional Page About The Role The Blockchain Security team sits within the Product Security & Assurance BA, part of the Information Technology and Security (ITSec) BU. Our mission is to support the security of Nu's crypto operation. In the context of Nu's global expansion, keeping these products secure, and demonstrably compliant with financial regulators, is a direct condition for our ability to operate and grow. As a Senior Security Engineer on this team, you own the security posture of our crypto operation. You are the person who thinks like an attacker so our products can withstand real ones: finding vulnerabilities before adversaries do, embedding product security into how crypto products are designed and built, and making sure our controls satisfy both internal risk standards and external regulatory requirements. You won't just run security tools. You'll build and operate the ones that protect our crypto products, from hardened ingress and monitoring/alerting systems to secure secret-management and automated security-review tooling. Your work directly protects customer funds and Nu's ability to run crypto products at scale. You’ll be responsible for Applying an offensive security mindset to our crypto and blockchain products: simulating attacks, running penetration tests and security assessments, and turning findings into concrete mitigations. Driving product security across the crypto portfolio: threat modeling, security-by-design reviews, and embedding secure practices into the development lifecycle. Building, operating, and improving in-house security services and tooling that integrate directly with our crypto products, for example hardened ingress/edge controls, security monitoring and anomaly alerting, secure secret-management, and automated security-review tooling. Ensuring our crypto operation meets regulatory requirements: mapping controls to applicable regulations, supporting audits, and producing the evidence regulators and internal risk teams expect. Collaborating with product and engineering teams to design secure blockchain architecture and embed security-by-design into new products. Contributing to security policies, standards, and guidelines that govern blockchain security operations. Using AI to raise the leverage and quality of security work: building and running AI‑assisted tooling for tasks like threat modeling, code and vulnerability review, and attack simulation, and helping the team push the frontier of what AI‑first security engineering looks like. Staying current on emerging attack vectors, exploits, and best practices across product and blockchain security, and sharing that knowledge across the team. We Are Looking For a Person Who Has Must have Strong product security and/or offensive security background (penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, attack simulation, incident response). Experience embedding security into product development: threat modeling, secure SDLC, security‑by‑design reviews. Hands‑on software engineering ability: you can build and operate security services and automation, not just use off‑the‑shelf tools. Comfortable writing production code (we work heavily in Clojure; strong experience in any modern language plus willingness to learn Clojure is fine). Solid working knowledge of blockchain and cryptocurrency fundamentals, including how blockchains, wallets, keys, and smart contracts work, enough to reason about their security (expert‑level depth not required, but real familiarity is). Strong knowledge of recent and past attack vectors and exploits, and how to remediate them. Experience with security frameworks such as OWASP and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF). Fluency with AI‑assisted engineering: using coding agents and LLMs in daily work, with good judgment about where they help, where they don't, and how to review their output critically. Familiarity with AWS, and solid grounding in operating systems, networks, databases, and infrastructure architecture. Ability to work autonomously and proactively, strong analytical/problem‑solving skills, and clear written and spoken English for technical and non‑technical audiences. Nice to have Deeper knowledge of blockchain/crypto internals: consensus algorithms, cryptographic protocols, smart contracts. Experience auditing smart contracts (e.g. Solidity) or working with DeFi protocols. Experience integrating with third‑party crypto custody/infrastructure providers (e.g. Fireblocks, Circle, and similar). Exposure to regulatory or compliance requirements in a financial or crypto context. Experience with bug bounties and/or CTFs. Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, or Certified Blockchain Security Professional. title: Commercial Contracts Specialist
description: We are seeking a Commercial Contracts Specialist to oversee and streamline our contract review and management processes in Brazil and LATAM. This role will be responsible for ensuring that all core-business contracts are reviewed efficiently, risks are identified and escalated, and internal stakeholders are supported with clear guidance and tools. This role will report to the company’s Senior Manager of Commercial Contracts, located in Brazil, and serve as the primary point of contact for business-related contractual matters in Brazil and LATAM. The ideal candidate has strong experience in technology, contract management, advanced English and Spanish expertise, and the ability to balance legal risk with business priorities. In this role, you will: Review, draft, and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements (customer, partnership, SaaS, NDAs, MSAs) in Portuguese and Spanish. Develop and update the company's contract structure in online sign-through agreements, facilitating product adoption and reducing friction. Get involved in strategic cross-border projects within all regions where VTEX operates, including LATAM, North America, EMEA and APAC. Build contractual framework over cutting-edge technology matters, such as Artificial Intelligence, Retail Media, and SaaS solutuons. Implement AI solutions to streamline contract workflows and reduce deal closure time. Ensure contracts align with company policies, compliance requirements, and risk appetite. Manage the end-to-end contract lifecycle, including intake, redlining, approvals, and execution, within the company's contract management tools. Partner with Sales and Alliances teams to negotiate strategic agreements with VTEX clients and partners within the digital commerce ecosystem. Provide cross-functional collaboration with internal stakeholders to ensure contracts reflect business practice, including Finance, Privacy, Information Security, Compliance, and Tech. Assist in optimizing and training local teams on the contract management system (CLM) and related tools. Ensure that global practices, internal processes, and internal controls are followed throughout contract negotiations and execution. Who you are An attorney licensed to practice law, with a commercial, contractual, and/or e-commerce background. With excellent communication, drafting, and negotiation skills in Portuguese. With advanced proficiency in English and Spanish. 3-8 years of legal experience at a leading law firm and/or in-house at a major multinational corporation. Experience in tech companies will be preferred. Available to work on site from Monday to Thursday in our offices in Rio de Janeiro or São Paulo. Curious, eager to learn as you go and think outside of the legal box; Enjoy working collaboratively. Able to think of secure and creative solutions for complex contract negotiations with clients. Have Interpersonal skills to effectively communicate and coordinate complex issues and projects with diverse levels of management and employees. Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Attentive to detail and have a sense of quality. Average user with basic knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Google Suite. Experience implementing or managing contract management systems (CLM) is a plus. About VTEX VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the composable and complete commerce platform that delivers more efficiency and less maintenance to organizations seeking to make smarter IT investments and modernize their tech stack. Through our pragmatic composability approach, we empower brands, distributors, and retailers with unparalleled flexibility and comprehensive solutions, enabling them to invest solely in what provides a clear business advantage and boosts profitability. VTEX is trusted by 2.400 global B2C and B2B customers, including Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker, and Whirlpool, having 3.400 active online stores across 43 countries (as of FY ended on December 31, 2024). Founded in the year 2000, VTEX has a history of being unstoppable. Completely against the odds, VTEX is leading a high‑tech industry and positioned above market giants. We are building an extraordinary future with more than 1,300 employees scattered across 25 locations in 16 countries in Latin America, North America, Europe, and Asia. For more information, visit At VTEX, you will work in a challenge-driven environment and collaborate with amazing peers. If you are powerful individually, join us, and we will be unstoppable together. title: Control Room Operator
description: The Control Room Operator is responsible for monitoring and controlling production processes and systems to ensure safe and efficient operations. The role operates the DCS, Fire & Gas, and ESD systems, monitors plant performance, and responds to operational deviations and emergencies. The position also supports well testing, troubleshooting activities, and accurate recording of operational data. Responsibilities Operate the DCS, Fire & Gas System, ESD System. (Emergency Shutdown). To act consciously and safely in times of emergency by understanding your role and following the OIM´s instructions. Monitor the correct operation of all plant and equipment. Log taking and understanding and interpretation of data. Work closely with DCS Technician on all matters concerning the DCS or PLCs. (Program to control the plant). Use the DCS efficiently and react immediately in case of emergency. Maintain historical trends of the various process systems. To fill out the shift logbook with all relevant information regarding fire and gas systems, process conditions, and inhibition, and to ensure it is properly recorded and archived. Perform well testing and ensure the correct data is obtained through a report to be presented Well Testing Department. Test the wells and ensure correct data collection through a report to be presented to the Well Testing Department. Participate on plant troubleshooting. Inform Production Supervisor when the system is unstable or malfunctioning. Other duties that are correlated to the function as directed and requested by Production Supervisor Or Production Superintendent. Keep up certification applied to the function and medical certificates up to date. Attend Company training as defined. Perform all emergency duties assigned to their function, in response to the emergency, if applicable. Ensure compliance with BW procedures, applied to the function, including BW Permit to Work System. Need to be fully familiar and comply with Company Policies, Quality, HSE and all Procedures assigned to his title/position. Anticipate and notice any unsafe condition and assure that the correction actions are taken according to procedure. Responsible for your own safety and for the safety of your co-workers. Education Technical education required; Engineering degree is a plus Advanced English Level Experience Experience as a Control Room Operator or in a similar role. Knowledge Knowledge of Fire & Gas (F&G) detection logic and Emergency Shutdown (ESD) system architecture, including shutdown levels and Cause & Effect matrix, sufficient to recognize abnormal conditions and respondperthecompany's instructions. Knowledge of process safety systems and safe operating envelopes of the topside process, sufficient to support troubleshooting and inform the Production Supervisor of instability or malfunction. Knowledge of shift handover and logbook recording requirements for fire and gas systems, process conditions, and inhibition status. #J-18808-Ljbffr

This role offers excellent exposure to strategic programs while developing core consulting, project management, and analytical capabilities. Oil & Gas – Why This Industry The Oil, Gas & Energy sector is undergoing significant transformation as it balances growing global demand with the transition to lower-carbon energy systems. At dss+, we help clients improve safety, optimise performance, and accelerate their sustainability and energy transition strategies. This is a key industry where we support organisations to navigate complexity and deliver long-term, sustainable impact. Your Impact at dss+ You will support the successful delivery of consulting engagements by helping project teams manage governance, track performance, monitor risks, and ensure alignment against strategic objectives. Develop your Trusted Expertise Gain early autonomy and real accountability, working closely with senior clients on complex, high‑impact challenges. Thrive in a Culture of Respect Join an inclusive and collaborative environment where your voice is valued, your curiosity is encouraged, and your wellbeing is supported. Shape your Career Accelerate your development through hands‑on experience, structured learning, and opportunities to work on international projects. Who You Are You bring strong analytical thinking, a structured mindset, and the ability to work effectively in complex and fast‑paced environments. You are comfortable working with data, managing multiple priorities, and supporting stakeholders through clear communication and high‑quality deliverables. Experience Experience supporting projects, PMO activities, business analysis, or consulting engagements Experience developing reports, dashboards, and management presentations Exposure to project planning, governance, performance monitoring, or operational improvement initiatives Experience within consulting, industrial, energy, or asset‑intensive environments is advantageous Capabilities Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining quality and accuracy Strong communication and stakeholder engagement capability Proactive mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability Results‑oriented approach with a commitment to excellence in execution Technical Skills Advanced Excel, including data analysis, dashboards, and pivot tables Advanced PowerPoint with experience preparing executive‑level presentations Knowledge of project planning, governance, and project controls Experience with Power BI, MS Project, or similar project management and reporting tools is desirable Familiarity with AI‑enabled solutions and productivity tools is advantageous Education & Languages Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field Postgraduate qualification or certification in Project Management or Finance is advantageous Fluency in English required Mobility Willingness to travel as required Growth & Benefits We invest in your development and success through: Structured learning and development, including our Consulting Development Academy Mentorship from experienced leaders and industry experts Opportunities to contribute to international projects Competitive salary, performance‑based incentives, and comprehensive benefits Flexible working policies A Bit More About Us We are implementers and change‑makers. Our teams work from the boardroom to the shop floor, helping organisations build resilience, improve performance, and sustain results over time. Our expertise spans industries including metals and mining, energy, chemicals, manufacturing, and private equity — combining deep operational knowledge with transformation and capability‑building expertise. Venha fazer parte do nosso propósito e viva, no seu dia a dia, o que é transformar a saúde com excelência, empatia e compromisso. Valorizamos o respeito, criando um espaço onde todas as pessoas se sintam seguras para serem quem realmente são. title: AR Game Designer — Mobile & WebAR - LATAM
description: About The Project We are developing an augmented reality entertainment experience that transforms physical family-friendly, Horror-themed tombstones into interactive monster encounters. About The Project We are developing an augmented reality entertainment experience that transforms physical family-friendly, Horror-themed tombstones into interactive monster encounters. The product combines physical retail merchandise with two levels of digital experience: Phase One — WebAR: A frictionless 10–15 second cinematic experience triggered by scanning a QR code. The monster appears to emerge directly from the physical tombstone. Phase Two — Mobile Game: A native iOS and Android experience where players confront monsters in their own environment using a supernatural “Van Helsing-inspired” weapon system, capture them, and return them to their graves. We are looking for an AR Game Designer to own the gameplay design and help turn the creative concept into simple, compelling, highly repeatable interactions. What You’ll Do Define the core gameplay loop for short-form AR monster encounters. Design intuitive mechanics that work naturally with a smartphone camera and physical tombstone. Develop the interaction between the player, monster, environment, and virtual weapon. Design a supernatural weapon mechanic capable of firing plasma or fantastical energy, weakening/capturing monsters, and dragging them back into their graves. Determine how each monster (3) behaves during encounters and where character-specific mechanics add meaningful value. Design encounters that are immediately understandable and satisfying within approximately 15–30 seconds while supporting longer play sessions. Establish progression, scoring, replayability, difficulty, rewards, and player feedback systems. Explore how leaderboard and competitive mechanics can extend engagement. Help determine whether multiplayer/social gameplay belongs in the initial product or future roadmap. Design onboarding that requires minimal instruction and gets users into the experience quickly. Work closely with AR engineers to design around real-world tracking, mobile hardware, performance, safety, and environmental constraints. Collaborate with animation, VFX, audio, character art, and engineering so gameplay mechanics feel integrated rather than layered onto the experience. Prototype, playtest, evaluate, and rapidly iterate mechanics based on client and user feedback. Help establish systems that can expand beyond Halloween into additional characters, seasonal variants, collectibles, and future experiences. What We’re Looking For Professional experience as a Game Designer, AR Game Designer, Systems Designer, or Gameplay Designer. Experience designing mobile, AR, VR/XR, location-based, or other interactive real-time experiences. Strong understanding of short-form gameplay loops and immediate player feedback. Ability to translate a broad creative idea into clearly defined mechanics, rules, states, and interactions. Strong understanding of player motivation, progression, reward, difficulty, and replayability. Experience designing gameplay around physical movement, camera-based interaction, or spatial environments. Ability to communicate mechanics clearly through design documentation, diagrams, prototypes, and direct collaboration with developers. Comfortable working in a fast-moving prototype environment where gameplay is continuously tested and refined. A portfolio of work is mandatory. Nice to Have Hands-on Unity experience. Experience with AR Foundation, ARKit, ARCore, 8th Wall, or comparable AR platforms. Experience designing combat, capture, projectile, aiming, or physics-based mechanics. Experience with physical products, toys-to-life, location-based entertainment, or connected collectibles. Familiarity with multiplayer and leaderboard systems. Experience designing family-friendly horror entertainment. The Design Challenge The gameplay should be family friendly and simple enough to understand immediately but satisfying enough that players want to do it again. This is not intended to become a complicated combat game. The “magic” comes from seeing a physical object come alive, confronting the creature in your own environment, and having an interaction that feels responsive, theatrical, and fun. The physical tombstone, AR character, weapon, VFX, animation, spatial audio, and gameplay should feel like one experience and not separate features. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Junior Data Management Analyst
description: Salary Range: R$48,000.00 To R$54,000.00 Annually Full Time Position, Monday - Friday The Company Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. Working alongside experienced professionals, you will gain hands-on experience with seismic, non-seismic, and well data while developing a strong understanding of data governance standards, industry best practices, and Katalyst's proprietary tools and processes. This position offers an excellent opportunity for individuals who are detail-oriented, eager to learn, and interested in building technical expertise within the energy data management industry. Maintain accurate time tracking using corporate tools and support timely handling of billing-related information. Update control systems, spreadsheets, activity records, indicators, and operational documentation, including process notes, decision records, issue tracking, and status updates. Identify, record, and engage errors, inconsistencies, routine data issues, and technical concerns to the responsible analysts or project team members. Support data preparation, basic reporting, storage monitoring, disk usage review, workflow progress tracking, and data quality reporting as requested. Follow information security, confidentiality, and data governance standards when handling client, project, and company data. Communicate clearly and professionally with client personnel, Katalyst operational staff, and project team members to support effective project delivery. Qualifications & Skills: Working knowledge of data transfer concepts, file organization, and data loading processes, with a willingness to learn Katalyst and client-specific systems. Basic understanding of subsurface data types, including seismic, non-seismic, well data, related documents, and associated file formats. Strong attention to detail and ability to follow documented procedures accurately. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with basic proficiency in English. Ability to identify routine problems, document findings, cross-reference information, and escalation issues appropriately. Collaborative mindset with a strong team orientation and willingness to support shared project goals. Knowledge of key Microsoft Office tools, including PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Outlook. Basic knowledge of Linux commands used to browse, query, and copy files. Basic knowledge of Python or another programming language. Basic knowledge of file integrity checking and related quality control concepts. Strategic thinking and analytical capacity to review, compare, and connect information from multiple sources. Ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain professionalism in a client-focused environment. Position Type and Expected Hours of Work: This is a full-time position. As a full-time position, the Junior Data Management Analyst is eligible to participate in benefits coverage offered to Katalyst employees based on geographical location. This position may be performed remotely, at a Katalyst office, or on a client site. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with occasional evening or weekend work required to support project or client needs. Required Education and Experience Undergraduate degree in data management, geoscience, information technology, databases, or a related field preferred. Minimum of two years of relevant experience in data management, geophysical or subsurface data support, data loading, data transfer, technical operations, or a related analytical environment. #J-18808-Ljbffr

As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring that all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details. Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modifications schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements. Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety-critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation. Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements. Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions. Analytical and Problem-solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions. Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence. Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands-on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly. Qualifications And Experience Engineering degree is mandatory. CREA-RJ accreditation is required. Post-Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage. Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred. Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable. Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders. Why Join Us? We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector.
